title: 第690章 好好表现第689章 反咬一口
slug: 被贬废丹房我偷偷无敌了
content_zh:
话音落下，立即就有几名修士押着两名火罗国的人走了上来。
这两名火罗国人乃是金丹初期的高手，现在体内的真气已经被封锁住，和普通人差不多，根本没有丝毫反抗之力。
庞太师道：“太子殿下，这两人是……”这两个人一个唱红脸一个唱白脸，配合起来非常默契。
太子道：“这是我抓捕到的火罗国奸细，你们说说，是如何刺杀先皇的？看看这里可有我们大楚国的奸细。”
“是。”
那两名火罗国人答应一声，眼神一扫忽然猛的指向四皇子，“是他！也就是你们的四皇子，大楚皇帝的一切信息都是他告知我们的，我们正是因为得到四皇子提供的准确信息才刺杀大楚皇帝成功的。”
“什么！怎么会这样？”
“是啊，原来先皇的死和四皇子有关，此人居然弑父，简直是大逆不道！”
“是啊，勾结火罗人，简直是罪不可恕！”
“没错，没想到四皇子此人居然如此歹毒，实在是罪不可恕！”
此言一出，众人顿时掀起了轩然大波，把四皇子说的跟大魔头一样，人人得而诛之。
太子郝天眼中脸上一丝阴谋得逞的表情，“来人，把四皇子这个大逆不道的皇子给我拿下，就地格杀！”
此言一出，顿时从四面八方飞扑过来许多高手，朝四皇子扑了过来，就打算把其打杀了，只要把四皇子杀了，那就是死无对证。
“你们敢！”四皇子头顶上出现一尊宝塔，宝塔中激射出来无数道土黄色气流，直接形成一个土黄色光罩，把他保护起来。
“魔头，还不伏诛！”
围攻四皇子为首的是一名老者，乃是一名金丹大圆满的高手林傲，这些人都是太子暗中培养的实力，绝对可靠。
林傲大手一抓，一道黑光打出，顿时把四皇子的宝塔打得滴溜溜旋转。
四皇子的宝塔叫做厚土宝塔，是陈长生给他的一件防身古宝，威力不小。
“哼，林傲，你想要拿下我也没有那么容易！”四皇子手中出现一把长鞭，猛的挥舞间，顿时犹如一条蛟龙，啪的一声，犹如天雷炸响。
那些大臣都生怕伤到自己，急忙往后倒退。

啪！啪！啪！
四皇子手中的鞭子抽动之间发出惊雷一般的响声，一道道球形闪电出现朝那些人炸了过去，顿时让他们一阵手忙脚乱。
四皇子知道他的父皇肯定在暗处偷窥，自己必须要好好表现一番自己的实力，让父皇看到自己的实力。
既然太子要抓自己，正好展现一下实力。
这件鞭子也是陈长生给他的一件古宝，叫做龙神雷鞭，是雷属性，威力非常大。
“哼，太子，你以为我这次凭什么能够击退火罗人。”
content_en:
As soon as the words fell, several monks came up escorting two people from the Fire Kingdom.
These two people from the Fire Nation were masters of the early Golden Elixir. Now that the true energy in their bodies had been blocked, they were almost like ordinary people and had no power to resist at all.
Taishi Pang said: "Your Highness, these two people are..." One of them is a good person and the other is a bad person. They work together very well.
The prince said: "This is the spy from the Huo Luo Kingdom that I captured. Tell me how you assassinated the late emperor? See if there are spies from our Chu Kingdom here."
"Yes."
The two Huo Luo people agreed, and suddenly pointed at the fourth prince with a glance, "It's him! That's your fourth prince. He told us all the information about the Emperor of Chu. It was precisely because of the accurate information provided by the fourth prince that we succeeded in assassinating the Emperor of Chu."
"What! How could this happen?"
"Yes, it turns out that the death of the late emperor was related to the fourth prince. This man actually killed his father. It is simply treason!"
"Yes, colluding with the Huo Luo people is simply an unforgivable crime!"
"That's right. I didn't expect that the Fourth Prince would be so vicious. It is truly an unforgivable crime!"
As soon as these words came out, everyone immediately started an uproar, calling the fourth prince like a big devil, and everyone wanted to kill him.
Prince Hao Tian's eyes showed a hint of a successful conspiracy, "Come here, take down this rebellious prince, the fourth prince, and kill him on the spot!"
As soon as these words came out, many masters rushed from all directions and rushed towards the fourth prince, intending to kill him. As long as the fourth prince was killed, it would mean death without evidence.
"You dare!" A pagoda appeared above the fourth prince's head. Countless khaki air currents shot out from the pagoda, directly forming an khaki light shield to protect him.
"The devil still won't be punished!"
The leader who besieged the fourth prince was an old man, Lin Ao, a master of the Great Perfection of the Golden Elixir. These people were secretly cultivated by the prince and were absolutely reliable.
Lin Ao grabbed it with his big hand, and a black light shot out, immediately making the fourth prince's pagoda spin.
The fourth prince's pagoda is called the Thousand Earth Pagoda. It is an ancient self-defense treasure given to him by Chen Changsheng. It is quite powerful.
"Hmph, Lin Ao, it's not that easy for you to take me down!" A long whip appeared in the fourth prince's hand, and when he swung it fiercely, it suddenly resembled a dragon, and the snap sounded like thunder from the sky.
Those ministers were afraid of hurting themselves and hurriedly stepped back.
Snap! Snap! Snap!
The whip in the fourth prince's hand made a thunderous sound when it was twitched, and ball lightning appeared and exploded towards those people, causing them to panic for a while.
The fourth prince knew that his father must be peeping in the dark, so he had to show his strength well and let his father see his strength.
Since the prince wants to catch him, it's time to show off his strength.
This whip was also an ancient treasure given to him by Chen Changsheng. It was called the Dragon God Thunder Whip. It had the attribute of thunder and was very powerful.
"Hmph, Prince, why do you think I can repel the Fire Luo people this time?"
